title: Wall Mount Towel Shelve 3-Tier Hotel Style 24.7-Inch Brass | Lavender | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Shelve 3-Tier 24.7-Inch | Allied Brass, Lavender
description:
Add space-saving storage with a wall mount towel shelve designed in a traditional bathroom hardware look in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. This three-tier, hotel-style towel shelf helps organize folded towels while using vertical wall space.

Highlights:
- Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Brass construction
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean installed look
- Includes mounting hardware; some assembly required

Specs:
- Category: Towel Shelves
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Dimensions: 24.7 in L x 8.9 in W x 10.4 in H; 3.5 in projection
- Weight: 5.6 lb
- Included items: towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and installation hardware
available in multiple designer finishes, including statement colors
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
